title: Network access: usable from anywhere, desktops on the tailnet
summary: A test machine must be usable from anywhere so QA runs from any controller, including cloud sessions and other networks. SSH is open to every source address with key-only authentication: password and keyboard-interactive SSH disabled, the registered Test Machine's SSH key authorized, and a dedicated non-admin test account. The desktop has two routes and never opens RDP or VNC to the public internet. desktop_route=direct is the default for a host on the tailnet: the controller connects to the registered MagicDNS host, whose desktop port each OS guide confines to the Tailscale interface, and a direct RDP route pins the host's self-signed certificate on first use. desktop_route=ssh-forward is the fallback for a host reached only by its public SSH address: desktop-access holds an ssh -N -L forward while it runs. SSH is not limited by source address. The rule lives once in the host-provisioning index under Network access and each OS guide links to it.
